{{Quote|Alderaan is ''destroyed...'' obliterated by a ''meteor storm...!'' Central Information told us that ''long'' ago...!|Arn Horada|<ref name="MSW30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref>}}
'''Central Information''' was a source of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] disseminated to worlds like [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It spread the falsehood that the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] was caused by a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor storm]], and the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] were all killed.<ref name="MSW30" />
